scripts.dev: yarn workspace @app/shared build && concurrently -n frontend,backend,website "yarn workspace @app/frontend dev" "yarn workspace @app/backend dev" "yarn workspace @app/website dev"
scripts.dev:carga: yarn workspace @app/shared build && concurrently -n frontend,backend,website "yarn workspace @app/frontend dev" "yarn workspace @app/backend dev:carga" "yarn workspace @app/website dev"
scripts.build: yarn workspace @app/frontend build && yarn workspace @app/backend build
scripts.test: yarn workspace @app/frontend test && yarn workspace @app/backend test
